name: Hauling

source.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens The Grand Bazaar

text:
Hauling weapons are adept at moving creatures around the battlefield after a successful attack.

Activate R Command

Frequency once per hour

Trigger You succeed at an attack roll to Strike with a weapon with the hauling rune

---

Effect The target must succeed at a DC 20 Reflex save save or be moved 5 feet in a direction you choose. This is forced movement.
